_comment: CBAM phase-in factors. Read at runtime; never hardcode these in R (KARBON_ATLASI.md section 7). The cbam_factor is the share of embedded emissions on which CBAM certificates must be surrendered in a given year. It mirrors the EU ETS free-allocation phase-out for CBAM sectors, reaching full application in 2034.

meta.primary_legal_source: Directive 2003/87/EC Article 10a(1a), as amended by Directive (EU) 2023/959; Regulation (EU) 2023/956 (CBAM Regulation)
meta.source_note: Figures transcribed from the European Parliament Legislative Train summary of the CBAM file. VERIFY against the Official Journal text of Directive 2003/87/EC Article 10a(1a) before publication; a secondary summary is adequate for development but not for a citation in METHODOLOGY.

notes.transitional_period: 2023-10-01 to 2025-12-31, reporting only, no financial obligation

de_minimis.basis: mass-based, per importer per calendar year
de_minimis.comment: Importers below this threshold are exempt. This project models facility-level exposure, not importer-level liability, so the threshold is recorded for context but is NOT applied in the calculation. Stating this in METHODOLOGY matters: it is one reason estimated exposure is an upper bound on what is actually surrendered.
